'''Giant slime''' is a miniboss found within the [[Dragonkin Laboratory]].

In Story mode its health is reduced by 50% and its damage output is reduced by 90%.

This miniboss can be found following the fight with Astellarn, beyond the gate locked by the celestial dragons to the east.
